description: AGSC-06-22 with AGSC-11-20: the line that /now/ and /now.md carry is `content version <bundle_version>, built at <instant>, fingerprint <bundle-hash>, specification <spec_version>` on a public node; on a restricted node it is `built at <instant>, specification <spec_version>`, because the content version and the fingerprint are facts that AGSC-11-20 keeps out of the discovery document and no file anyone may read can carry them. Two nodes with the same facts, public and restricted. Derived by hand from the rule.
